title: COMP 3522 C++ · Week 3
subtitle: Classes, constructors, copying, destructors, inheritance, virtual functions, testing with Catch, UML, preparing for Quiz 3 and Lab 3
description: Everything in the Week 3 slides and sample projects, taught from scratch: structs and classes, the default constructor and the most vexing parse, member initialization lists and default arguments, the copy constructor and shallow versus deep copies, destructors, forward declarations, inheritance and the three access levels, polymorphism with virtual functions, plus the testing and debugging deck, Lab 3's stack with Catch unit tests, and the UML review. Every slide program is runnable and stepped; a mock quiz and a cheat sheet close the week.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 3 scope
Written at the start of lab on the Learning Hub in the usual format (multiple choice, true/false, matching, what-does-this-print). It covers the **Week 3 slides** (both decks), the **Week 3 sample projects** (Circle, Complex, Visibility, myVec, polymorphism, private, virtual, virtual2, whichconstructor), and the **Testing review** and **UML review** decks posted with Lab 3. Every one of those programs is reproduced here, runnable, with its real output.
:::

print it and read it on the way in
